metadata.scenario: A returning client is concerned about an incorrect invoice they received. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Helen Johnson. I’m calling about an invoice I received, and I think there’s been a mistake. Hi, Helen! I’m sorry to hear that. What seems to be the issue with the invoice? Well, I was charged for two physical therapy sessions last week, but I only attended one. The charges seem off to me. I understand your concern. Let me pull up your account to take a closer look. Thank you, I appreciate it. I’ve been a client for nine months now, and I usually keep track of everything. Yes, of course. Just a moment, please... Okay, I see your account here. You did have one session last week. Exactly! So why am I seeing two charges? It looks like there was a billing error on our end. I’ll need to have our billing department correct this. I hope it can be resolved quickly. I don’t want any issues with my account. Absolutely, Helen. I’ll make sure to prioritize this for you. Can I have your preferred contact information for follow-up? Sure, you can reach me at my cell, +13165552580. Thank you. I’ll pass that along. Would you like me to send you a confirmation email when it’s resolved? Yes, that would be great. I sometimes forget about calls. Not a problem! I’ll also check in with the therapist about your last session. Good idea. I just want to make sure everything is in order. I’ll take care of that. Also, while I have you on the line, are you interested in scheduling another therapy session? Hmm, I might be. I could use another session soon, but I’ll wait for the billing issue first. Of course, that’s understandable. I’ll follow up with you once the billing is corrected, and we can schedule then. Sounds good to me. Thanks for your help, Margaret. You’re welcome, Helen! Thank you for your patience. Have a great day! You too, bye! Goodbye!
